pages.text: $(l)Top priorities:$() get to the Nether, unlock EMC, then push into Chapter 2. Bedrock armor is optional but strongly recommended.$(br2)Don't build big infrastructure yet. Automation really starts in Chapter 2, once you have AE2 and the Void world.
Set up only what you need to get there.

$(l)How the chapters are split:$()$(li)Chapter 1: the start.$(li)Chapter 2: begins with Pure Fluix and the Elite Crafting Table.$(li)Chapter 3: the Wormhole.$(li)Later chapters: "from the stars" (Eden, Wildwood and so on).
The pack is long and is designed to be played slowly. Play for as long as it's fun. The pack isn't built around "finishing".
